verdict.rationale: AI Gateway supports rate limiting (fixed/sliding, requests per time window) and dynamic routing explicitly lists 'restricting each user/project/team with budget/rate limits,' which supports per-key/per-agent guardrails. However, there's no clear evidence of per-agent API key issuance with hard spend caps that block spend once a budget is exceeded—rate limiting is request-count based, not dollar-budget based, so 'runaway spend' protection is only partially addressed.
